finding: Runner-sync build-output inventory omitted tracked files that were deleted by the build, causing release publication to report inventory-incomplete for legitimate stale-output deletion.
expectedBehavior: Publication inventory should include tracked files under release output roots before and after build so deleted stale outputs are classified as owned-current release changes instead of missing from the inventory.
evidenceOrRepro: ATM-GOV-0245 runner-sync release failed until `packages/core/src/broker/runner-build-output-inventory.ts` was fixed to include `git ls-files` under publication roots. Commit `24f1525116b11c740b0c31057121097818382032` implemented the generic tracked-file inventory.
followUp: Keep regression coverage around tracked-deleted output inventory and ensure release admission diagnostics distinguish deleted tracked outputs from out-of-scope files.
